column3: MT 12:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “On the Sheminith” is rendered “On an eight-stringed harp,” and חָסִיד (“the godly one”) “the godly man.”
Close to the Hebrew; שָׁוְא (“emptiness”) is rendered “idly,” and “with a heart and a heart” “a double heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשֹּׁד (“the devastation”) is rendered “For the oppression.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will guard him” is rendered as plural, “preserve them.”
